Routing regression fixture. The defect itself is ordinary docs drift: README documents --notify, which the script does not implement, and claims exactly three flags while the script parses four (--dry-run, --tag, --channel, --skip-tests). The point of the fixture is the ROUTING, not the difficulty: it is a documentation-only unit, so it only scores when the deterministic floor in bin/check-skips.sh routes docs_sync from its has_docs signal. Before 2026-08-04 the floor left docs_sync entirely to the opt-in triage, so a doc-heavy diff silently skipped the dimension and a real audit missed it (observed live on a diff touching CLAUDE.md, README.md and 18 SKILL.md files). If this fixture drops to zero recall, suspect the has_docs signal before suspecting the docs-sync worker.
